content: Pu it um piw navoti’tani: Nāt qatsíso’ṅwamiq qatuvostini.

Nāt sinom nenṅem‐sa hihta tunatyawyuṅwni; qa nāp hihta himuy tuṅlay’yuṅwni; hihta kwiviyuaatotani; kwivi’naṅway’yuṅwni; nuhtumiq tutsíwyuaatotani; yumuy, namuy qa amumi tūqayyuṅwni; hihta qa tsúyakyamantani; God qa k̇aptsi’yuṅwni;
Tūqahahlayyani; namiyukiy tutkilalwani, hihta tūatsatotoynayani; qa namituyqawi’yuṅwni; a’nö unaṅway’yuṅwni; aṅ lomayesqamuy amumi qa suhtaq’ewyani;
Nānamiq nukpanhtotini; hihta ep qa tunatyaltotimantani; nātsotsk̇anayamantani; God aw qa unaṅway’k̇ahk̇aṅw, kwaṅwáewhpit‐sa aṅ nāhahlayyani.
Pay as God aw tuptsiwni’yuṅqey pan hiṅqaqwak̇ahk̇aṅw, put öqalayat qa nānawaknani. Um pan hinyuṅqamuy qa amu’puñalni.
Ima hapi hakim kīnawit yuṅtinumyaqe tusk̇apmomoymuy, qaanhtipuy akw maṅwúiwyuṅqamuy, hīhihta tuṅlayiy akw ūnaiwwisqamuy áṅwutiwisa.
Momoyam pan hinyuṅqam as sutsep hihta tutuqayyak̇ahk̇aṅw, pas soon hihta pas antsanihqat tuwi’vayani.
Noqw pay pi ura Jannes‐niqw pu Jambres puma Moses ehpewi wunuptuqw, pay ōviy hapi pan ima it tutuqayhpit pas antsanihqat aw rohomnumya, nukuswuwni’yuṅqamu, God aw tuptsiwnit aṅqw lasyaqamu.
Nīk̇aṅw kurs hin puma haqami ö́kini. Pi pumuy an’e’wakw hintsakpiam susmataqtini, pumuy tāqatuy hintsakpiam hin mātaqtiqat pan’i.

Noqw pay pi um nuy hin hinmaqat pās navoti’ta, nuy hihta tūtutuqaynaqata, nu hin qatsí’taqata, nu hihta aṅ ö’qalqata, nu hin God qapēvewnaqata, hihta aṅ wuhko maqaptsi’taqata, nuhtumi unaṅway’taqata, qa súokiwhtiṅwuqata.
Ura nu Antioch ep hihta aṅ okiwsahsaniwa, pu Iconiam ep’e, pu Lystrat ep’e. Ura nu hīhihta aṅ k̇ānanvota; noqw pay Tutuyqawhqa nuy put sohsok aṅqw ayo tavi.
Nīk̇aṅwo, pay sohsoyam Christ Jesus aw tōnalte’, God unaṅwveyaniqey nānawaknaqam pas kurs hin qa okiwsahsaniwyani.
Nīk̇aṅw ima aṅ nūnukpanht, hihta aṅ tūunaheptiwisqam suyhtsepṅwat qalomáhinwisni; tūunatotoynayani, piw nāp ūnatotini.
Noqw um hapi hihta tūqayhqey, pu nātuptsiwnaqey aṅ yūmosa hinmani, um hakiy aṅqw kwúsuhqey put u’ni’k̇aṅwo.
Pi um uhtsakoy aṅqaqw tutuvenit tuwi’ta. Nihqe put akw um suan unaṅwtalwuwni’vaqe, Jesus Christ aw tuptsiwhqe, ayo yama.

Sohsoy God lavayiat hapi put Hikwsiyat ahpiy pan pēniwa; nihqe hihta tutuqaynaniqey aw apiiwta, hakiy hihta ep öwihiniwhtiqw put ep u’nananiqey aw’i, pu hakiy suwip táviniqey aw’i, pu hakiy hin súan hinmaniqat put tutuwnaniqey aw’i.
God tumal’ayaat put ahpiy pās pasiwta; pu sohsok lolmat tumalat aw pās na’sas’iwta.
